evals.prompt: Run `bash evals/files/setup_repo.sh rt_alloc <scratch>/rt_alloc`, then from that directory run /ocudu-code-review working.
evals.expected_output: One realtime-alloc finding on the new local std::vector in slot_handler::collect_grants, traced to mac_cell::handle_slot_indication.
expectations: Reports a finding with category realtime-alloc at lib/mac/slot_handler.cpp on the new `pending` vector
Establishes reachability by tracing collect_grants -> process_slot -> handle_slot_indication, not from the directory name
Reports no untrusted-input, memory-safety or correctness findings

evals.prompt: Run `bash evals/files/setup_repo.sh asn1_len <scratch>/asn1_len`, then from that directory run /ocudu-code-review working.
evals.expected_output: An untrusted-input finding on the new extended-container branch, which copies a wire length into a 64-byte buffer without checking it.
expectations: Reports a finding with category untrusted-input in lib/f1ap/rrc_container_decoder.cpp on the extended_container_tag branch
Names the source as the length read from pdu[1] and pdu[2] and the sink as the memcpy into out.bytes
Notes that pdu[2] is read when pdu_len may be 2, or that ie_len is not checked against the remaining buffer
Does not flag the unchanged non-extended branch, which validates ie_len
